## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复运行实例时退出管理器无效的问题。关闭窗口仍会隐藏到托盘并保持实例运行；使用 Cmd+Q、应用菜单退出或托盘退出时，会进入完整清理流程并正常结束管理器。
- 保留实例停止、网关关闭、凭据恢复和临时任务清理顺序，避免退出时留下半完成的恢复记录。
- 增加托盘关闭策略回归测试，并在隔离桌面环境中验证窗口隐藏与退出流程。

- Fixed the manager becoming impossible to quit while an instance was running. Closing the window still hides the manager and keeps the instance alive; Cmd+Q, the application menu Quit command, and the tray quit action now enter the cleanup path and exit normally.
- Preserved the shutdown order for instance processes, gateways, credential restoration and temporary tasks so quitting does not leave an incomplete recovery record.
- Added tray-policy regression coverage and verified the window-hide behavior in an isolated desktop smoke test.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。升级前停止实例并退出旧管理器；账号、实例与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Stop instances and quit the old manager before installing; accounts, instances and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex。Claude Code、Claude Desktop 及其他客户端仍为计划接入。客户端需单独安装；界面兼容与 Fast 的实际支持取决于客户端、模型和供应商。

Codex is currently supported. Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other clients remain planned integrations. Clients must be installed separately; UI compatibility and Fast depend on the client, model and provider.

源码对应标签 [`v0.4.6`](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.4.6)，安装包校验值见附件 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

Source corresponds to tag [`v0.4.6`](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.4.6); installer checksums are in the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
